summary: A search box that fires a search event a moment after you stop typing.
description: A MozInputText subclass rendering a native <input type="search">. Debounces input by 500ms before dispatching its own MozInputSearch:search custom event, and exposes a clear() method that empties the value and fires the search event immediately.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: The text of the label element. Inherited from MozBaseInputElement via MozInputText.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The name of the input control. Inherited from MozBaseInputElement via MozInputText.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The value of the input control. Inherited from MozBaseInputElement via MozInputText.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: The disabled state of the input control. Inherited from MozBaseInputElement via MozInputText.

attributes.name: required
attributes.description: The required state of the input control. Inherited from MozInputText.

attributes.name: iconSrc
attributes.description: The src for an optional icon. If unset, a default search icon is still shown (own inputTemplate() treats iconSrc === undefined as "has icon"). Inherited from MozBaseInputElement.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Text for the description element that helps describe the input control. Inherited from MozBaseInputElement via MozInputText.

attributes.name: supportPage
attributes.description: Name of the SUMO support page to link to (attribute: support-page). Inherited from MozBaseInputElement via MozInputText.

attributes.name: placeholder
attributes.description: Text to display when the input has no value. Inherited from MozInputText.

attributes.name: ariaLabel
attributes.description: The aria-label text when there is no visible label. Inherited from MozBaseInputElement via MozInputText.

attributes.name: ariaDescription
attributes.description: The aria-description text when there is no visible description. Inherited from MozBaseInputElement via MozInputText.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: The title attribute, mapped onto the inner input. Inherited from MozBaseInputElement via MozInputText.

slots.name: description
slots.description: Inherited from MozBaseInputElement: rendered when the description property is unset, letting callers supply richer description markup.

slots.name: support-link
slots.description: Inherited from MozBaseInputElement: rendered when supportPage is unset, letting callers supply a custom support link element.

events.name: input
events.description: Native input event as the user types; own handleInput() calls the inherited handler to update value, then restarts a 500ms debounce timer.

events.name: change
events.description: Redispatched from the native input's change event so it crosses the shadow boundary.

events.name: MozInputSearch:search
events.description: Bubbling, composed CustomEvent (detail: { query: value }) dispatched 500ms after the user stops typing, or immediately/synchronously by clear() if the field had a value.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the value (on both the property and the underlying input element) and synchronously dispatches MozInputSearch:search if the field had a value.

cssParts.name: label
cssParts.description: The internal <label is="moz-label">, inherited from MozBaseInputElement's shared render().

cssParts.name: support-link
cssParts.description: The optional support link, inherited from MozBaseInputElement's shared render().
